title: Hearty Spicy Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A spicy and dense Spanish dish featuring tarragon leaves, this keto-friendly paella is perfect for a family dinner. It is kid-friendly and can be prepared with namul-blanch-season method.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the chopped tarragon leaves to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the cauliflower rice to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and diced tomatoes to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Serve the paella hot, garnished with additional tarragon leaves if desired.
